bullish: 4H candle closes above both EMA 20 and EMA 50
bearish: 4H candle closes below both EMA 20 and EMA 50
neutral: 4H EMA direction and candle close do not fully agree
No new position until bullish or bearish criteria are complete

long: The confirming 1H candle closes above EMA 20
Enter only after the confirming 1H candle closes
short: The confirming 1H candle closes below EMA 20
Enter only after the confirming 1H candle closes

exit_rules: Exit a long when a 1H candle closes below EMA 20
Exit a short when a 1H candle closes above EMA 20
Exit immediately when the 4H EMA 20 and EMA 50 cross against the position
Expected holding period is 2 to 5 days, but exit signals take priority over elapsed time
risk_rules: Risk no more than 1% of current account equity per trade
Set the initial stop 2 times the 1H ATR 14 from entry
For longs, also account for the latest clear 1H pullback low
For shorts, also account for the latest clear 1H rebound high
Calculate position size from the final stop distance
Never widen a stop; it may only move toward profit
Long and short positions may be used; account for leverage and liquidation risk
notes: Use the 4-hour chart for trend direction and the 1-hour chart for entry, exit, and stop management. Designed for BTC and ETH swing trades typically lasting 2 to 5 days. This is a rules template, not financial advice.
